_comment: Frozen Maelstrom arena (#102), read by scripts/arena/maelstrom_ground.gd. Game metres, Y up, arena centre at the origin. Gameplay values: changing any of them is a gameplay change (bump WireCodec.BUILD). The playable ice is a ring between the eye and the jagged rim, tilting down toward the bottomless eye (eye_depth) and ending at a low rim over the thin frozen sea. A bot whose origin drops below kill_y, or whose centre leaves the ring onto the sea, is eliminated (reason 'maelstrom') instead of being put back on its last floor; its wreck breaks through and sinks until sink_depth below kill_y. Obstacles are authored for one half and mirrored through the centre, with the fleets swapped, so both teams face identical ground. Model hulls come from data/maelstrom_hulls.json (art_source/maelstrom/build_kit.py).

bowl._comment: The frozen whirlpool's profile: the ice climbs tilt metres from the eye lip to the rim on the flanks (X axis), lane_share of that along the team lanes (Z axis), with an extra funnel_depth metres of sag easing out by funnel_outer metres from the centre. The frozen sea lies sea_below_rim metres under the rim; it is thin ice, so a bot whose centre leaves the ring by more than exit_margin metres is eliminated too.

swell._comment: Broad frozen swells following the spin: sin(2 * spiral phase) times height metres, fading near the eye and the rim.

ridge._comment: Two frozen spiral pressure ridges (log spirals r = eye_radius * exp(twist * angle), 180 degrees apart): a sharp tent profile height metres tall and half_width metres to each side of the crest, fading out near the eye and the rim.

slabs._comment: Upthrust ice slabs: rise along yaw from the ice to height over length, then drop sharply. Makeshift jump ramps.
